Build all 4 service pages for the Boldteq marketing site: 1 full Website Development page + 3 Coming Soon pages.

**Project:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq`
**Stack:** Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, CSS Modules

**IMPORTANT:** Read CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md first. This project uses Next.js 16.2.3 — read `node_modules/next/dist/docs/` for any breaking changes. Never use `any` type.

**Read first:**
- `src/components/shared/coming-soon-page.tsx` — for the 3 Coming Soon pages
- `src/components/how-it-works/process-steps.tsx` — numbered steps pattern
- `src/components/how-it-works/how-works-steps.tsx` — navy section with feature cards
- `src/app/pricing/page.tsx` — page pattern
- `boldteq-v1-0.webflow/services/website-development.html` (from line 343) — content source

## 3 Coming Soon Pages (simple!)

### `src/app/services/ui-ux-design/page.tsx`
```tsx
import { createMetadata } from "@/lib/seo/metadata";
import { ComingSoonPage } from "@/components/shared/coming-soon-page";

export const metadata = createMetadata({
  title: "UI/UX Design Services | Coming Soon | Boldteq",
  description: "User-centric designs that drive engagement and conversions. Coming soon from Boldteq.",
  path: "/services/ui-ux-design",
});

export default function UIUXDesignPage() {
  return <ComingSoonPage serviceName="UI/UX Design Services" description="User-centric designs that drive engagement and conversions." />;
}
```

### `src/app/services/graphics-design/page.tsx`
Same pattern. Title: "Graphic Design Services | Coming Soon | Boldteq", description: "Visually striking designs that strengthen your brand."

### `src/app/services/app-development/page.tsx`
Same pattern. Title: "App Development | Coming Soon | Boldteq", description: "Custom apps designed for speed and scalability."

## Website Development Page (full page)

### `src/app/services/website-development/page.tsx` (server component)
Metadata: title "White-Label Web Development for Agencies | Boldteq", description: "Boldteq provides reliable, senior-level web development as part of a single monthly subscription — delivered under your brand.", path: "/services/website-development"

### `src/components/services/service-hero.tsx` + `.module.css`
- Badge: "Web Development"
- H1: "White-Label Web Development for Agencies"
- Subtitle: "Boldteq provides reliable, senior-level web development as part of a single monthly subscription — delivered under your brand, built for agency workflows."
- 4 stat badges: "White-Label by Default" (`Layer_1-3.svg`), "Senior Developers" (`Layer_1-4.svg`), "Subscription-Based Delivery" (`Layer_1-5.svg`), "NDA Protected" (`Layer_1-6.svg`)
- 2 CTAs: "View Pricing" → /pricing, "Book a Demo" → /book-a-demo

### `src/components/services/service-pain-points.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Why Web Development Becomes a Bottleneck as You Grow"
- Badge: "Why Agencies Struggle"
- Subtitle: "As agencies scale, web development becomes the hardest part to manage..."
- 4 cards with emoji icons:
  1. ⏱️ "Deadlines Slip" — "Dev bottlenecks delay launches. Clients notice. Relationships erode."
  2. ⚠️ "Quality Drops" — "No two freelancers deliver the same standard — inconsistency kills agency credibility."
  3. 🐢 "Slow Hiring" — "Recruiting, onboarding, tools, salaries — all before a single line of code ships."
  4. 🛡️ "Client Trust at Risk" — "Every late delivery, every buggy handoff chips away at your agency's reputation."

### `src/components/services/service-capabilities.tsx` + `.module.css`
Navy section: "What Our Web Development Team Handles"
- Badge: "What We Handle"
- Subtitle: "Boldteq takes care of the technical execution so your team doesn't have to manage builds, fixes, or ongoing client requests."
- 6 feature cards (2x3 grid, navy bg, white text):
  1. 🏗️ "Full Website Builds" — "End-to-end website development..." — badge: "Most Requested"
  2. 🛍️ "Shopify Development" — "Custom themes, sections, store builds..." — badge: "E-Commerce"
  3. ⚙️ "WordPress Development" — "Custom theme development, Gutenberg blocks..." — badge: "CMS"
  4. 🧩 "Custom Components" — "Reusable, responsive UI sections..." — badge: "UI Components"
  5. 🛍️ "Bug Fixes & Support" — "Fast resolution of layout, functionality..." — badge: "Priority Support"
  6. ⚡ "Speed & Core Web Vitals" — "Image optimization, lazy loading, caching setup..." — badge: "Performance"

### `src/components/services/service-platforms.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "Platforms We Support"
- Badge: "Platform Expertise"
- 2 cards side by side:
  1. "Shopify Development" — description + "See Shopify Scope" CTA to /scope
  2. "WordPress Development" — description + "See WordPress Scope" CTA to /scope

### `src/components/services/service-process.tsx` + `.module.css`
Section: "How We Bring Products to Life"
- Badge: "How It Works"
- Subtitle: "Our four-step approach bridges the gap between imagination and execution..."
- 4 numbered steps:
  1. "Choose a Plan" — "Pick a subscription based on your delivery volume..."
  2. "Submit via Portal" — "Share tasks through your private portal..."
  3. "We Build & QA" — "Senior developers handle execution and thorough internal QA..."
  4. "Client-Ready Delivery" — "You receive fully tested, white-label deliverables..."

### Page composition:
```tsx
<ServiceHero />
<ServicePainPoints />
<ServiceCapabilities />
<ServicePlatforms />
<ServiceProcess />
<CtaBanner />
<BetaCta />
```
